ASTA_TOKEN.description: Optional Asta API token for the asta CLI and skills; leave blank and run `asta auth login` instead.

postAttachCommand.preview: if [ -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" ]; then url="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-4848.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}/"; else url=http://localhost:4848/; fi; echo "Quarto preview: $url"; if python3 -c 'import socket; socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 4848), 2).close()' 2>/dev/null; then :; elif [ -f Makefile ]; then make preview; elif [ -f _quarto.yml ]; then quarto preview --no-browser --port 4848; fi || { echo "Quarto preview failed; see the errors above." >&2; exit 1; }
